query:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(
                CASE reason
                    WHEN 'purchase'   THEN quantity
                    WHEN 'adjustment' THEN quantity
                    WHEN 'sale'       THEN -quantity
                    WHEN 'loss'       THEN -quantity
                END
            ), 0) AS "stock!"
            FROM stock_movements
            WHERE product_id = $1
